tag: claims: How has our payment method mix changed over the last six months?

facts: Apr 2026: Apple Pay 15.5%, Card 45.9%, Capitec Pay 6.6%, Pay by Bank 21.0%, PayShap Request 10.9%
May 2026: Apple Pay 18.4%, Card 43.4%, Capitec Pay 7.7%, Pay by Bank 19.4%, PayShap Request 11.1%
Jun 2026: Apple Pay 22.2%, Card 40.8%, Capitec Pay 9.0%, Pay by Bank 18.2%, PayShap Request 9.8%
Jul 2026: Apple Pay 26.1%, Card 38.1%, Capitec Pay 10.9%, Pay by Bank 16.1%, PayShap Request 8.9%
Aug 2026: Apple Pay 30.1%, Card 35.1%, Capitec Pay 12.2%, Pay by Bank 15.0%, PayShap Request 7.6%
Sep 2026: Apple Pay 33.7%, Card 31.0%, Capitec Pay 14.6%, Pay by Bank 13.7%, PayShap Request 7.0%
claims: apple pay surged while card share dropped
Over the six months from Apr 2026 to Sep 2026, Apple Pay climbed from 15.5% to 33.7% to become a major driver of the payment method mix.
Meanwhile, card share declined from 45.9% in Apr 2026 down to 31.0% in Sep 2026.
Capitec Pay also grew from 6.6% to 14.6%, while Pay by Bank and PayShap Request both decreased over the same period.
